summary: An interactive map about hypothetic analogue of the Moon and Mars on Earth with useful, simple interfaces and data filters that show information, statistics and images of the places to explore. It's aimed towards space enthusiasts and features translation tools. This addresses the challenge by raising conscience about our own landscape here on Earth and calling the community to share their own research.
details: It's an HTML-based interactive map showing locations on Earth that are hypothetically analogous in some capacities to Mars or the Moon. It could bring more scientific and general attention to the places listed. It's intended for enthusiasts and amateur researches to document and help gain knowledge on these places. Apart from the free CARTO API for the map and Leaflet to put it in our code, we only ever used HTML, CSS and JavaScript for the site. What distinguishes it is its interactiveness, and the fact it rests upon the scientific and enthusiast community to grow.
